Units: CPU microseconds per 32-event burst; frame waiting excluded
Limitations: Raw0 includes event routing/harness overhead; no claim of isolated evaluator timings
Semantic mode has no predecessor API equivalent; compare its absolute cost, not a fictitious baseline
Performance.TIME_PROCESS is a periodically refreshed monitor and may be stale; its diagnostic samples are not per-frame CPU percentiles
Synthetic headless viewport workload; no physical-device or rendered-frame speed guarantee
